name: Millets of Mewar
why_it_matters: Opened 2 October 2011 — India's oldest dedicated millet-based restaurant, ranked by India Today as one of the country's healthiest. Ragi, jowar, bajra sourced rain-fed from regional farms. Vegan-friendly by default, gluten-free menu without the up-charge.
insider_tip: It's a working community restaurant linked to Shikshantar Andolan — they take orders at the counter and seat you when ready. The millet pizza is the dish to start non-millet-eaters on.
signature_address: 16, Bhim Parmeshwar Marg, Hanuman Ghat, Outside Chandpole, Udaipur 313001

name: Lalghat Cafe & Restaurant
why_it_matters: Rooftop attached to Lal Ghat Guest House — one of Udaipur's longest-running budget rooftops, now in its second generation. Mewari thali at backpacker prices, plus a small Lebanese mezze section for Israeli/European guests staying upstairs.
insider_tip: Walk-in only and seating is first-come — arrive 5:30pm to claim a lakefront ledge before the sunset rush. Cash preferred.
signature_address: 33 Lal Ghat, behind Jagdish Temple, Udaipur 313001
